title: [Performance] enable torch.compile for the deepseek V4.1
body:
- Decorate DeepseekV41Model with @support_torch_compile so the V4.1 backbone is captured by vLLM's compile path. It was the only DeepSeek model in vllm_ascend left undecorated: deepseek_v4/model.py and deepseek_v41/dspark.py already opt in. Without the decorator the backbone stays outside FX-graph compilation, so the npugraph_ex passes and the static-shape kernel optimization never apply to it.
- Mark dim 0 of input_ids, positions and intermediate_tensors as dynamic. Dim 0 is the token dimension for all three (the forward uses positions.shape[0] as the token count), so the compiled graph stays reusable across batch sizes instead of re-specializing per shape.
